sam: Running the sampleapp onboarding e2e and hit a weird dup-write + order mismatch when the embed batcher retries. Repro attached.

jess: Seen this pattern before. Which SDK versions?

sam: node SDK 0.12.1, python 0.9.3. Node consistently returns embedding field and keeps order, py sometimes swaps items and uses `vector` key. Snippet: ```REQUEST: {"items": [{"id":"a","text":"foo"},{"id":"b","text":"bar"}], "request_id":"r123"} RESPONSE (node): [{"id":"a","embedding":[0.1,0.2]}, {"id":"b","embedding":[0.3,0.4]}] RESPONSE (py): [{"id":"b","vector":[0.3,0.4]}, {"id":"a","vector":[0.1,0.2]}]```

mike: Likely culprit: batch helper converting to a map and losing original indices, combined with retry merging logic. JS object iteration order can be non-deterministic depending on construction.

ria: Also saw auth->retry interaction: one subrequest 401 causes full-batch retry without idempotency token, server processes duplicate entries. Logs: `[2026-03-17T14:02:11Z] embed-service incoming batch size=2 client_request_id=(missing)` then `auth: token expired -> 401` then client retries entire batch.

sam: Exact log sample pasted in the issue.

jess: Short-term mitigations: 1) batcher should send items as an array and attach `_pos` index to each item, 2) SDKs should normalize response keys to `embedding`, 3) include per-batch or per-item idempotency header.

mike: I prototyped adding `_pos` in sampleapp and that fixed mapping on retries. But we need SDK parity tests: Python currently unwraps differently. I'll open a Node SDK PR to canonicalize field and add per-item idempotency and tests for auth->retry.

ria: Longer-term: server can accept partial retries (only retry failed IDs) to avoid reprocessing. Also server should honor `X-Request-ID` and reject duplicates if seen.

sam: For unblock I'll push a small sampleapp shim: force array order, attach `_pos`, emit `X-Request-ID`. Will PR and rerun e2e.

deploy-bot: deploy failed: sampleapp-onboard-e2e #34 - assertion failed: "vector for id a matches expected"

jess: Filed GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/issues/4283 "batcher: preserve order & normalize response fields" assigned to @mike

mike: will draft PRs for Node SDK and sampleapp. Adding integration test that simulates token expiry mid-batch.

sam: Can someone add a quick note to onboarding docs (docs/onboarding) about BATCHER_STRICT_ORDER env var as a workaround for CS?

jess: Done, doc patch queued.

sam: Thanks all :thumbsup: I'll re-run e2e after PRs land and report back.
